cloudkms.cryptoKeys.list: To list the encryption keys that can protect the restored disks.
cloudkms.keyRings.list: To list the key rings that hold those encryption keys.
compute.disks.create: To create the disks that receive the restored data.
compute.disks.delete: To delete a disk, so a failed export or restore can be cleaned up.
compute.disks.setLabels: To set labels on each restored disk.
compute.disks.use: To use a restored disk, so it can be attached to a VM instance.
compute.disks.useReadOnly: To use a disk as the read-only source of a restore.
compute.firewalls.list: To list the firewall rules that can apply to the restored VM instance.
compute.instances.attachDisk: To attach a restored disk to a VM instance.
compute.instances.create: To create the VM instance that receives the restored data.
compute.instances.delete: To delete a VM instance, so a failed export or restore can be cleaned up.
compute.instances.detachDisk: To detach a disk from a VM instance during a restore.
compute.instances.setLabels: To set labels on the restored VM instance.
compute.instances.setServiceAccount: To set the service account that the restored VM instance runs as.
compute.instances.setTags: To set network tags on the restored VM instance.
compute.instances.start: To update the power state of a VM instance, by starting it after a restore.
compute.instances.stop: To update the power state of a VM instance, by stopping it before its disks are swapped.
compute.networks.list: To list the networks that the restored VM instance can attach to.
compute.subnetworks.use: To attach the restored VM instance to a subnetwork.
compute.subnetworks.useExternalIp: To attach an external IP address to the restored VM instance.
iam.serviceAccounts.actAs: To attach a service account to the restored VM instance.
